faq.question: Q1. What is SGPGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SGPGIMS Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment notification inviting applications for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) and Project Technical Support-III posts under an ICMR-funded research project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SGPGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, with 1 post for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) and 1 post for Project Technical Support-III.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SGPGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by Speed Post is 12-10-2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in life sciences including integrated courses, with preferred experience or Ph.D. in Microbiology, Virology, or Biotechnology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: Candidates require a B.Sc. in life sciences or B.Sc. (MLT) with three years post-qualification experience, or an M.Sc. in life sciences or M.Sc. (MLT).
